description: This file defines the ItemRepository class, which provides data access methods for 'Item' entities in a database using Dapper and Npgsql. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting items, implementing typical CRUD operations with pagination support.

classes.name: ItemRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing 'Item' entities in the database, providing asynchronous CRUD operations with pagination and filtering support.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of items along with the total count of items, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Fetches a single item by its unique identifier; returns null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new item into the database and returns the created item.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing item identified by its ID; returns the updated item or null if not found.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes an item by ID; returns true if the deletion was successful.
